title: Shifted OR verifier
statement: Given a Boolean verifier $M$ and functions $p,k:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, define a verifier on strings $(x,u,v)$ as follows: it outputs true if and only if, for some integer $i$ with $0\le i<k(|x|)$, $M$ outputs true on $x$ and the string obtained by taking the length-$p(|x|)$ segment of $u$ beginning at position $i p(|x|)$ and XORing it bit by bit with $v$.
hypotheses_covered: Functions p and k from natural numbers to natural numbers are given
The output is the disjunction over i in range(k(|x|)) of the stated verifier evaluations
The segment is drop(i p(|x|)) followed by taking p(|x|) bits, then bitwise XOR with v
